entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I hope you can help me. I bought a helmet a few weeks ago, and I really need to return it. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF9128-445. I feel awful about this. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I really needed this money for something else that's come up unexpectedly.

Thank you for that, and we certainly appreciate your loyalty. Let me pull up that order... Okay, I see the EnduroGuard helmet here, delivered 27 days ago. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with the helmet itself. The box is still completely unopened. It's the color. On the website, it looked like a deep forest green, but in person, it's much brighter. It just clashes with all my other gear.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important for your kit. And your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
So... can I return it? I was so worried I was outside the window.
Of course. That helmet is a standard item, and our policy allows for returns within 90 days. You're well within that timeframe, so I can approve this return for you right now.
Oh, wow! Really? That's such a relief. I was preparing for the worst. Thank you so much!

You're very welcome. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund.
That is perfect. You've really helped me out today, Diana.
I'm happy I could help. Is there anything else for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
